within_dataset_b.primary_endpoint: mean over k in {3,5,8} of AUC(with) - AUC(without), variant A, rows <= k; lagged (rows <= k-1) as sensitivity

within_dataset_b.rule: affect adds information only if CI lower bound > 0 AND point estimate >= 0.005; primary/lagged disagreement = not robust
